rationale: Extracts the existing CTest non-run observer from workflow YAML into a bounded source-owned Python helper, adds duplicate-safe baseline artifact comparison, and publishes its JSON projection beside the raw non-Windows CTest XML. The observer remains non-gating and does not change test selection, CTest verdicts, runner routing, packaging, release behavior, or design/render authority. The design-output-and-packaging family is crossed by exactly one path: docs/status/tools.yaml, whose registry row makes the checkout-only evidence helper discoverable to agents and generates the matching CLAUDE.md catalog entry. The other changed paths are the helper and tests, CI observation wiring, local-CI documentation, and the CI skill; they match no Vellum watch selector. No importer, DesignIR schema, generated design output, template, installed SDK, product artifact, renderer, asset pipeline, or Vellum-owned source changes. Registered as watch-only so selector coverage stays exact without claiming an authority move.
